insurer: IFFCO TOKIO General Insurance Company Limited
sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (₹1.5L and above referenced)

room_rent.note: For SI ≥ ₹5L: actuals, no cap. For SI < ₹5L: 1.75% of SI/day in Class A cities, 1.50% elsewhere. Room cap removable for SI < ₹5L on payment of 6% extra premium.

icu.note: For SI ≥ ₹5L: actuals. For SI < ₹5L: 3% of SI/day in Class A cities, 2.5% elsewhere. Proportionate deduction does not apply to ICU charges.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base plan. Optional co-pay of 10%, 20% or 25% can be chosen; once opted cannot be removed during policy period.

sub_limits.display: Modern treatments capped at 50% of SI; domiciliary at 20% of SI
sub_limits.note: Modern treatment methods covered up to 50% of SI per policy period. Domiciliary hospitalisation capped at 20% of SI. No disease-wise sub-limits on standard hospitalisation for SI ≥ ₹5L.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 36 months of continuous coverage. Reduced by prior continuous coverage under portability/migration.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Cataract, BPH, hysterectomy for menorrhagia/fibromyoma, hernia, hydrocele, fistula, piles, sinusitis, cholelithiasis/cholecystectomy — 12-month waiting period.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 100% of base SI (25% yr1, 10%/yr after)
cumulative_bonus.note: 25% CB after first claim-free year, then 10% per subsequent claim-free year, max 100% of basic SI. CB reduces at accrual rate on a claim. Alternatively, a 5% no-claim discount on premium can be chosen instead.

restoration.display: Once per claim, 100% of basic SI
restoration.note: Basic SI reinstated to full amount after each claim (first reinstatement free; subsequent reinstatements charged pro-rata premium). Not available for listed chronic/critical illnesses, domiciliary hospitalisation, cumulative bonus, or critical illness extension. Reinstated SI not usable for same illness relapse within 45 days.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days prior to hospitalisation for the same condition.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 90 days after discharge for the same condition.

day_care.note: Specific list of 383 day-care procedures covered (Annexure C). List is dynamic.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered up to 20% of SI aggregate per policy period. Several conditions excluded from domiciliary cover (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, etc.).

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment including pre- and post-hospitalisation covered up to the sum insured per policy period.

organ_donor.note: Donor hospitalisation expenses covered subject to insured's sub-limits. Donor's room rent limited to 50% of insured's room rent entitlement. Ambulance, pre/post-hosp and daily allowance not payable for donor.

ambulance.display: Up to 1% of SI or ₹2,500, whichever less
ambulance.note: Road ambulance charges per hospitalisation limited to lower of 1% of SI or ₹2,500.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, stem cell therapy, etc.) covered up to 50% of SI per policy period.

consumables.note: Standard non-medical consumables (gloves, masks, etc.) listed as non-payable in Annexure A List I. No consumables rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Territorial limit clause restricts all treatment to India only. Claims payable in Indian currency only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim or policy contestable except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for renewal and non-monthly instalments; 15 days for monthly instalments. Coverage not available during grace period after policy expiry.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from receipt of policy document at inception only (not on renewals or portability).

portability.note: Portability to same product with other insurers permitted with continuity of waiting periods and accrued benefits.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, infertility/ART, adventure sports (non-professional too), acupuncture/acupressure, OPD-only procedures converted to IP, intra-articular injections, external congenital defects, 90-day wait for diabetes/hypertension complications

optional_riders.display: Higher SI for Critical Illness cover; No-limit room rent/ICU (6% extra premium); Co-payment options (10%/20%/25%)
